{{Quote|It's about time you got here. Take over&mdash;I'm headed to the Chief of State's quarters.|Mirith Sinn to Leia Organa's boydguards|<ref name="CEIII2" />}}
The '''Chief of State's quarters''' were a suite of private chambers used by the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The quarters were located in residential compound of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], the quarters were assaulted by the henchmen of [[Ennix Devian]], [[Supreme Commander]] of the [[Restored Empire]] faction, but the attack was thwarted by the security staff of the Palace.

==History==
{{Quote|They'e headed toward the family's quarters.|Mirith Sinn|<ref name="CEIII2" />}}
[[File:Aborted_raid_Empire_LostIII.png|thumb|left|The Imperial raid was aborted at the doors of Organa's quarters]]
When she succeeded [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] as [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] relocated to the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and she was offered this plush suite. Organa moved into the Chief of State's quarters with her [[Han Solo/Legends|husband]] and [[Darth Caedus|her]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|three]] [[Anakin Solo|children]].<ref name="DS">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>

[[13 ABY/Legends|Two years later]], a group of [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial commandos]] were tasked by the [[Restored Empire]] leader [[Ennix Devian]] to [[Phase One|raid]] the Chief of State quarters to eliminate Chief of State [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Solo family/Legends|her family]]. The raid was foiled by [[Mirith Sinn]], [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] of the Palace and Organa's [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]. Devian's henchmen were stopped at the very door of the Chief of State's suite.<ref name="CEIII2" />

==Layout==
This suite was located in the living compound of the Palace, and could be accessed from the [[Imperial Palace Meeting Hall|Meeting Hall]].
The quarters' door was fronted by a fine portico made of carved square columns and cusped arches. Patterns carved on the pillars ranged from zigzags to [[Plant/Legends|floral]] and sheer geometric designs. It was brightly [[Color/Legends|colored]] with blue, gold and tan.<ref name="CEIII2" /> The quarters themselves contained several chambers, including a common room and at least two [[Sleeper (furniture)|bedrooms]].<ref name="DS" />
